problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.notes: textbook Dijkstra from a single source; the answer is the max of all shortest distances, or -1 if unreachable

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.notes: Bellman-Ford limited to k+1 relaxation rounds; plain Dijkstra needs a state-augmented (node, stops) graph instead

problems.title: Path With Minimum Effort
problems.notes: Dijkstra where 'distance' is minimized max-edge-weight along the path, not the summed weight

problems.title: Path with Maximum Probability
problems.notes: Dijkstra with multiplication instead of addition — use a max-heap since probabilities shrink as you multiply

problems.title: Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination
problems.notes: Dijkstra plus a count-ways-to-reach-in-shortest-time DP layered on top of the standard relaxation step

problems.title: Evaluate Division
problems.notes: weighted-graph BFS/DFS, or Floyd-Warshall for small graphs — build the graph from the equations before answering queries

problems.title: Find the City With the Smallest Number of Neighbors at a Threshold Distance
problems.notes: Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest paths, O(n^3) is fine since n <= 100 — a good 'when is cubic acceptable' discussion

problems.title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
problems.notes: plain BFS on a grid with 8-directional moves — a good baseline before layering on A*-style heuristics

problems.title: Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes
problems.notes: BFS over (node, visited-bitmask) state space — a Held-Karp-style shortest path over a small node count
